An animation repeats: a one-shot played again every period (rich-animation-42lg.cjy) (#499)

* An animation repeats: a one-shot played again every period (rich-animation-42lg.cjy)

Animation.repeat(period, nth) is nth(n) through the nth turn, on its own
clock from 0, turns of either sign. The turn is read through the wrap a beat
and Phase.loop already use (easing.ts passAt, which beat now reads too), so
a repeat turns on the same float as a loop of its period. glyph-effects and
transitions drop their hand-written copies, one of which never reported the
cut into the previous turn when run backwards.

* Review: each repeated turn made once, -0 turn named 0, playground kit repeats through Animation.repeat (rich-animation-42lg.cjy)
